exposure: childbirth and parenting education (CPE) via telehealth
outcome: consumers' and clinicians' experiences and perspectives of using, accessing, or providing CPE via telehealth
access to CPE if telehealth was not available
impact of telehealth classes on clinician workload management
cohort: A total of 279 survey participants and 21 interview participants, comprising rural and remote consumers (prospective parents) and clinicians, who had experiences and perspectives regarding childbirth and parenting education via telehealth.
finding: Findings support the continuation of telehealth CPE classes, with hybrid availability where possible, despite many still preferring face-to-face education.
cross-section timing: Data was collected via online surveys and 1:1 online interviews exploring current or recent past experiences and perceptions of using, accessing, or providing childbirth and parenting education via telehealth.
